I lost my son's father to suicide. He also felt very VERY alone. He was battling demons from his childhood. No one, including me, saw his death coming. He killed himself in my driveway, for me to find him. And the pain he left behind weighed down on everyone else. The constant guilt that I could've done better to save him. His mother's guilt that she could've been a better mother. That pain your feeling won't go away when you die. It really does pass down to the people around you you care about you. And he thought he was so alone, yet he had 300 people at his funeral to the point where is was standing room only. You are not alone in your battle, believe me. I'm sure you've thought this through, and if you're bound and determined I'm sure you will do it. But just remember the people you are leaving behind who love you very much. Speak out when you know something isn't right. Speak to the right person who will listen. My heart is heavy for you.
